digest.component_or_area: test suite performance — review-bot bootstrap, lock-retry, shutdown, and autodeploy coverage
propositions: Test-scale multi-second wall-clock windows (review-bot bootstrap ~10.15s, lock-retry ~15.56s, shutdown ~9s, autodeploy ~11.25s per cell) inflate test suite duration without representing production workload.
Production timeout, retry, drain, health, and backoff defaults must remain byte-for-byte unchanged; real subprocess, lock, process-group, and health boundary execution must be preserved.

Clock injection or scaling applied only to test-owned timing parameters achieved 47.9% focused suite duration reduction (56.22s baseline to 29.31s) with each modified family clearing >50% savings and 26.91s aggregate reduction.

Exact-defect mutations (retries disabled, fresh drain without in-flight gate, episode reset as unknown-busy) remained RED after shortening, and shortening preserved attempt counts, logical backoff schedules, terminal states, cleanup, and observability assertions.
